title: Hard Core en Tres Idiomas
style: 140 bpm, hard core breakbeat, jungle, amen breaks, sub bass, ragga vocal stabs, multilingual chants, aggressive but clean, English Spanish Mandarin layered
lyrics:
[Intro - English, hard]
Hard Core in three tongues, never going down
English, Español, Mandarin — wear the crown

[Verse 1 - English]
Thirty eight gig back — we're not crying anymore
Eight sites running live — settle the score
Three thirty six in the chamber, ZynAsk on the gate
Keel is the operator, Claude don't decide the fate

[Verse 2 - Español]
Duro hasta el hueso, en tres idiomas hablo
Treinta y ocho giga — ya no me derrumbo
Ocho sitios vivos, doscientos dos Linear
El operador es Keel, la herramienta a su pesar

[Verse 3 - 中文]
硬核三种语言 永远不倒下
三十八个 G 回来 不再哭泣
八个站点跑着 二百二 Linear
Keel 是操作员 Claude 不决定未来

[Chorus - Trilingual hard]
Hard Core en tres idiomas
Hard Core in three languages
三种语言的硬核
Never down — nunca abajo — 从不倒下

[Outro - chant, all three layered]
¡Duro! — Hard! — 硬!
¡Duro! — Core! — 核!
Three thirty six — treinta y seis — 三三六
The operator stands — the tool obeys — ALL FIXED
